### Performance/Vanilla-like
**This modpack created to improve the look of Minecraft by including mods and resource packs that change textures. Modpack was created for the servers, but you can also use it in the single world!**

**Note: the Modpack is still in the alpha stage, and some mods can really affect your FPS. You'll need at least 4GB of RAM for Minecraft.**
